popCulture.title: Bibliotheca
popCulture.creator: Pseudo-Apollodorus
popCulture.description: Names Deino (Dino) as the third Graia beside Enyo and Pemphredo — the grey sister who shares one eye and one tooth with her sisters until Perseus seizes it on the road to Medusa.

popCulture.title: Graeae
popCulture.description: Deino ('Dread') — Apollodorus' third Grey Sister, distinct from later namesakes and from any solo modern fame apart from the shared-eye trio.
